patch.value: Consume the canonical pm-ops attestation gate rather than carrying a twentieth vendored copy

This package was scaffolded from the fleet starter, which still carries the publish-attestation gate as vendored source: scripts/shell-command-scan.ts and scripts/verify-release-publish-attestation.ts are copies, not launchers. Nineteen repositories already carry nineteen divergent versions of exactly these files, and the fleet is converging them onto canonical exports published by pm-ops so a bypass fixed once is fixed everywhere.

Scaffolding a new package from the starter therefore creates a twentieth copy the moment it is created. It must join the same convergence wave rather than be treated as a special case, and it cannot converge until pm-ops publishes the exports: the released pm-ops 2026.8.31 exports only the package root, docstrings and assurance, while shell-scan and attestation exist on an unmerged branch.

The docstring gate is already the shape to copy, since scripts/docstring-gate.ts is a thin launcher over the canonical pm-ops docstrings export.

Both scripts are thin launchers over the published pm-ops exports rather than copies; a test fails if the gate is a local copy rather than the resolved package export, so a later hand edit cannot re-fork the lineage
pm-ops must publish the shell-scan and attestation exports first
